# Chain

Type: Material | Internal ID: Chain | Source: Wraith, ,, Sunken Crypts | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Chain is an item which can only be found as a drop or loot. It cannot be crafted.

## Availability

• Wraith drop
• Found as loot in Sunken Crypts chests.
• Found in Swamp Chest, located at various Point of interest in the Swamp.
• Found in chest in Sealed Tower.
• Found by deconstructing hook and chains in Dvergr Harbors and Dvergr Excavation Sites.

### Building

• Forge bellows
• Hanging brazier
• Iron cooking station
• Dvergr lantern pole
• Dvergr wall lantern

### Crafting

• Black metal shield
• Black metal tower shield
• Wolf armor chest

### Upgrading

• Black metal shield
• Black metal tower shield
